findings.description: CheckRequest::parse maps every serde failure to JevError::encode_failed (v1.rs:563-564). The same pattern is in CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes (payload.rs:408-409). The code is INPUT_INVALID, as the ADR requires. But the EncodeFailed hint reads 'could not be encoded as JSON ... Retry; if it persists, report it as a bug' (error.rs:833). That is the wrong guidance for a malformed caller body or payload. Sprint item 9 asks for InputInvalid with a fix hint, and this is the opposite of a fix hint. The variant is also an encode-side recovery category in ADR-SAG-0027, and these are decode failures. I am not marking it Blocking because the ADR fixes only the code mapping, and ErrorCode, exit code and retryable() are all correct.
findings.remediation: For decode failures, return JevError::input_invalid(format!('Jev wire body is not valid: {category} at line/column; fix the body')). The detail must carry only category and position. Alternatively add a decode-side constructor to sc-agent-types. Apply the same change in payload.rs:409. If the owner prefers to defer, record it as a tracked follow-up bead.

notes: HEAD is 085dab4 on sprint/r-5-jev-wire-envelope, as assigned.
Closure of the earlier reviewers' findings, checked in code:
- RBP-F001: CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes now maps serde errors through JevError::encode_failed. That keeps only the error category and line/column, so the raw serde text is never formatted.

- RBP-F002: the String errors and prefix sniffing are replaced by a private typed RuleViolation in payload.rs. It converts into JevError::input_invalid, and sc-jev-check's parse_question keeps the rule text only for InputInvalid.
- RBP-F003: request_json_error maps the Data category to one generic hint, consistently.
- RBP-F004: Question::new is now Question::new_unchecked, gated behind #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-util"))]. The sc-jev-backends test uses new_unchecked.
- RBP-F005: ChoiceId::yes() and ChoiceId::no() exist in ids.rs.
- RBP-F006: into_answers iterates request.questions and looks up each answer once, after a length check.
- RSH-002: http_failure in sc-jev-backends/src/backend.rs now returns 'HTTP {status}' only. The test in tests/llm.rs asserts that SENTINEL-RESPONSE-BODY and the key do not appear in the error.

CanonicalJudgePayload::new stays public, and I judge that acceptable. The deviation from RBP-F004 is real but benign. Question can now only be built through try_new or deserialization, so every Question handed to new already satisfies its kind rules. The remaining payload-level invariant, duplicate question ids, is enforced by PayloadBundle::encode, and from_bytes re-validates. Public new therefore cannot produce an invalid bundle. Optional follow-up (minor, not a finding): add a doc line on new saying it relies on Question being pre-validated.
sc-jev-py was excluded as instructed, because its link failure is pre-existing (RQA-QA-001 disposition).
Docs changes (requirements ids, ADR index row, plan.md D9) were not reviewed in depth, since they are outside this agent's scope.
